{{Top|leg}}
'''Mining refinery platforms''' were vast, self-contained vehicles that roamed the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] surface of [[Sevarcos II]]. Once a deposit of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] had been found, shafts were extended from the platform into the surface. Spice-encrusted rocks were [[Mining/Legends|mined]] by prisoners and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] using [[Sonic hammer/Legends|sonic hammer]]s and [[Cutting torch/Legends|cutting torches]] then moved via [[grav-cart]] to the platform. The raw spice was refined on the platform through the use of huge sifters and electrostatic chambers.
